name: Ayatsuri no Kyoushitsu
source:
Main character sneaks into his Alma mater school as a half joke with friends, but he can't get out. If he escapes somehow, he gets killed. Eventually memories of old cases of hypnotism at their school revive in everyone's heads.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公半开玩笑地和朋友们潜入母校，却发现再也无法离开。即便设法逃脱，也会被杀死。最终，昔日校内催眠事件的记忆在众人脑中重新浮现。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
